pages.text: $(bold)Magic Conduction$() (default armor trait of Arcane Iron, $(bold)leveled$())$(br2)Reduces $(bold)all magic damage$() taken by $(bold)5% x (level + 1)$() - 10% at level 1 and 20% at level 3.$(br2)Multiple armor pieces $(bold)stack$() (chained multiplication): four level 1 pieces give about 34%.$(br2)$(bold)What counts as magic damage$() (checked in order):$(li)vanilla witch-resistant tag (magic / indirect magic / sonic boom and more)$(li)the $(bold)forge:is_magic$() tag - Goety registers 8 types, Celestial Core 2$(li)damage types whose name contains magic$(li)namespace fallback: $(bold)irons_spellbooks.*$() (the nine schools) and $(bold)goety.*$() (Goety spells)$(br2)$(italic)Note: Iron's Spells registers its tag under the neoforge namespace, which does nothing on Forge 1.20.1 - hence the namespace fallback.$()
